issues.reason: The condition is semantically represented by the closed trigger, but the required target concept is not realized as a distinct exact state endpoint in the closed transition. The composite endpoint is a structurally different target from the contract's autonomous state locus.
issues.requirement_quote: when front_distance > 10, auto transport to autonomous state
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The author-source inventory and closed model both use AutonomousMode as the autonomous operating scope, so the phrase autonomous state may be intended to denote that composite rather than a child state; this interpretation could defeat the endpoint mismatch.

issues.basis: NL5 requires the autonomous state to reach the final state on power off. The source inventory identifies AutoFinalState as the authored final-state target, while the closed model routes the autonomous composite to the external final pseudostate through transition:line:24 and uses AutoFinalState only as an internal child.
issues.expected: On Power Off while autonomous operation is active, execution reaches the authored AutoFinalState completion state and remains terminated there.
issues.observed: The closed model has Power_Off consumers from AutoInitialState, AutoOperationalState, and AutoFinalState that exit the AutonomousMode composite, and transition:line:24 then routes AutonomousMode to the root final pseudostate. There is no closed-model transition from the autonomous state to the authored AutoFinalState on Power Off; AutoFinalState has an outgoing human-steering transition, so it is not stable termination.
issues.reason: The required endpoint is present only as a broader composite exit, and the designated final-state path can terminate at the root final pseudostate while the authored final child remains a continuing state. This is a termination-property mismatch, not merely an endpoint existence issue.
issues.requirement_quote: when power off, it will transit to final state
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The closed model's AutonomousMode-to-root-final transition could be interpreted as semantic completion of the autonomous scope, but the supplied authored source explicitly names AutoFinalState as the final state and gives that state a continuation to HumanDrivingMode.
